name: Morse.IsGeodesicallyComplete
why: Both: for every q ∈ N and v ∈ T_qN the geodesic from (q,v) reaches t = 1. Project: (q,v) ∈ expDom (open interval (-δ,1+δ)); blind: a geodesic on the closed [0,1]. Equal for every slice submanifold via restriction / extend_closed, with tangent spaces identified by tsp_eq.
